info.title: Mobile API
info.description: All mobile API endpoints for Athanasius Scouts

get.summary: Get seasons/events or events by season
get.description: If person_id is provided, returns seasons with events for that person (only if person_id matches authenticated user). Otherwise requires season_id and returns events for that season for the authenticated user.

parameters.name: person_id
parameters.description: Person ID (must match authenticated user). If provided, season_id is ignored.

parameters.name: season_id
parameters.description: Season ID (required if person_id not provided).

get.summary: Get persons list for a season event (legacy query)
Get persons list for a season event

post.description: Caller can only save for themselves (ServentID must match authenticated user).

get.description: Returns inventory items, qetaat, and event types for dropdowns.

post.description: Creates a new custody request with items. No duplicate inventory items allowed.

get.summary: Show one custody request (must be mine)

put.summary: Update pending custody request (must be mine)
put.description: Updates request fields and replaces items. Only allowed while status is pending.

delete.summary: Delete pending custody request (must be mine)
delete.description: Only allowed while status is pending.

post.summary: Login and get access + refresh tokens
post.description: Validates user credentials then returns a short-lived access token (1 hour) and a long-lived refresh token (30 days).
Revokes the current access token (Sanctum) and revokes active refresh tokens for the user.

get.description: Returns events for a selected season.

get.summary: Get drive links by SeasonEventID (query param)
get.description: Returns drive links for selected SeasonEventID. Also returns preview_link for embedding.

get.summary: Get drive links by SeasonEventID (path param)
get.description: Same as /api/media/links but uses a path parameter.

post.summary: List persons accessible by the user
post.description: Returns persons in groups/qetaat visible to the provided user id. Adds full_name in response.

id.description: User/Person ID used to filter accessible persons

get.description: Returns person full profile data (joined tables) and entry questions/answers.

QuestionText.example: Why do you want to join?

get.description: Returns events accessible for a person via their group/qetaa membership.

post.description: Uses refresh_token to issue a new access token and rotate refresh token. Old refresh token becomes revoked.
